name: ValidatePdfExistance
label: Validate PDF Content
description: Validates whether a PDF file contains text or images based on the selected content type

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: PDF File Path
fields.description: Full file path of the PDF document to validate

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: PDF Content Type
fields.description: Select whether to check for Text or Image content in the PDF

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Does Pdf Contain
fields.description: Returns true if the selected content type exists in the PDF; otherwise false
